summary: Iteration 17 - Remote full-screen portal + First-Night Checklist + modal centering. Backend: 7/7 pytest pass on test_iter17_checklist.py. Auth gates both /api/checklist and /api/checklist/{id} (401 unauthenticated). GET /api/checklist returns 14 items with all required fields (id/group/title/hint/auto/manual_allowed/done/target) + done/total; manual_allowed set exactly for {install, ipad_wifi, tv_setup, ptz_presets, remote_access}. POST /api/checklist/ipad_wifi {done:true} ticks and done count rises; POST /api/checklist/pin -> 400 'This step is detected automatically'. Changing PIN away from 1234 flips 'pin' item to auto=true, done=true; restored to 1234. PUT /api/matrix/map with valid defaults flips 'matrix_wiring' to auto=true, done=true. Frontend (390 and 1920): Watch tab open-remote-* opens apple-tv-remote which exactly covers the viewport (0,0,390,844 and 0,0,1920,800), remote-siri visible, all 10 remote buttons (up/down/left/right/select/menu/home/playpause/volup/voldown) clickable, close-remote-btn dismisses; no horizontal overflow. Settings -> settings-checklist-card opens checklist-panel full-screen via portal (0,0,390,844), checklist-progress-text='1 of 14 done' (matrix wiring remained confirmed from backend test), checklist-progress-bar present, 14 checklist-item-* rows. Manual tick checklist-tick-ipad_wifi toggles done count 1->2->1 instantly. Auto-item tick (checklist-tick-pin) is disabled. checklist-go-amp_live closes the panel and scrolls Settings to settings-amp. checklist-go-all_green opens Device Health panel. checklist-refresh-btn and checklist-close-btn work. Matrix identify modal via Settings -> matrix-identify-open-btn renders in BODY (portal) and fully covers viewport (0,0,390,844); identify-tv-* buttons still present; matrix-identify-close-btn closes. Scene create-scene-modal and automation-modal fully in-viewport at both 390x844 and 1920x1080 (centered, not clipped). No horizontal overflow at 390px for remote, checklist, matrix identify, scene modal, or automation modal.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py still ~1633 lines; refactor to routers (auth, matrix, checklist, display, audio, ptz, scenes) is overdue.
checklist() computes auto/done for 14 items on every call and probes device_health (~1.3s). Consider caching health or using an If-None-Match/ETag path so the UI refresh is snappier.

pin_changed heuristic compares against DEFAULT_PIN env (default '1234'). If an installer changes DEFAULT_PIN but leaves the hash matching the new default, 'pin' will not mark done. Acceptable for MVP; worth a comment.

FirstNightChecklist uses polling via load() only on open/refresh. Consider refreshing when relevant settings mutate (e.g. after PUT /api/matrix/map or PUT /api/config) to update auto ticks without manual Refresh.

AppleTVRemote renders siri, pad and buttons; the fixed inset-0 portal with a flat overlay prevents the previous translate drift. Good. Consider making the panel focus-trapping / Escape-to-close for accessibility.
test_credentials: PIN 1234 (demo bypass used; PIN restored to 1234 after change test).
seed_data_creation: matrix_wiring_confirmed=true remains in state as a side-effect of PUT /api/matrix/map test (defaults preserved tv_living=1, tv_office=2, tv_master=3, tv_guest=4; atv1..4 -> 1..4). checklist_manual.ipad_wifi left as false (toggled on and off). PIN restored to 1234. No LIVE devices toggled.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Checklist endpoints: GET /api/checklist (auth required, ~1.3s due to device_health probe) returns {items[14], done, total}. POST /api/checklist/{item_id} {done:bool} only accepts manual IDs = {install, ipad_wifi, tv_setup, ptz_presets, remote_access}; other IDs return 400. Auto-detected: install (any device online), pin (hash != 1234), matrix_live (config.matrix.live), matrix_wiring (state.matrix_wiring_confirmed - set true by PUT /api/matrix/map), tv_setup (4/4 PSKs AND tv.live), amp_live (config.amp.live), atv_paired (4/4 appletv with credentials+airplay_credentials), ecobee_paired (config.ecobee.paired), cam_stream (camera.rtsp_url), cam_apikey (camera.protect_api_key), all_green (health.online==health.total). Frontend: FirstNightChecklist and AppleTVRemote and MatrixIdentify all use createPortal to document.body with fixed inset-0. Checklist 'go' uses setTimeout 100ms then scrollIntoView; target 'all_green' opens Device Health panel (special-case in SettingsDrawer onGo).
rca of the issue: User bug 'remotes cut off bottom-right' RCA: AppleTVRemote previously used position:fixed+translate centering inside a framer-motion tab wrapper whose CSS transform established a new containing block, so the 'fixed' positioning drifted and clipped. Mitigation: render via createPortal to document.body with 'fixed inset-0' flat layout + large close-remote-btn. Verified at 390x844 and 1920x800 the apple-tv-remote bounding box is exactly {x:0,y:0,w:vp.w,h:vp.h}. Same translate-centering bug applied to Scene and Automation modals -> switched to m-auto centering; both now sit fully inside viewport.
